# La Mesa — Ceramics Studio & Creative Lab

> La Mesa is a ceramics studio and multidisciplinary creative lab located in La Barceloneta, Barcelona. We offer weekly classes, drop-in sessions, wheel throwing courses, creative workshops and private sessions. Tone: welcoming, informal, community-focused. We are hosts, not teachers.

## Services
- Taller Semanal Modelado (weekly hand-building class): €120/month — 4 sessions of 2h, 1×/week. Book online via Stripe Checkout.
- Taller Semanal Torno (weekly wheel-throwing class): €120/month — 4 sessions of 2h, 1×/week. Book online via Stripe Checkout.
- Clase Suelta Modelado (drop-in hand-building): €45 — one 2-hour class. Book online via Stripe Checkout.
- Clase Suelta Torno (drop-in wheel, private, max 2 people): €65 — one 2-hour class. Book online via Stripe Checkout.
- Intro al Torno (wheel intro course): €90 — 2 sessions of 2h, max 2 people. Book via WhatsApp.
- Coworking Torno (open wheel access for experienced potters): €20/hour — minimum 2 hours. Book via WhatsApp.
- Bono de horas / Taller Flex (flexible hours, hand-building or wheel): 8h €120, 16h €220, 24h €300. Buy via WhatsApp (https://wa.me/34711552030).
- Creative workshops (with guest artists): variable, see website.
- Private sessions (team building, birthdays, bachelorette): custom quote.
- Handmade tableware for restaurants and custom ceramics: small plates, plates, bowls and cups in high-fire stoneware, made to order in custom sizes and colours. Purchase (no minimum order, volume discounts, shipping across Europe) or rental for 4, 6 or 12 months (Barcelona area only, delivery and collection included). Lead time: a few weeks. Price on quote via WhatsApp or email.

All materials and firings included. High-temperature clay. Full machine-readable pricing: https://lamesabcn.com/pricing.md

## Booking
- Online (Stripe Checkout): Taller Semanal (Modelado/Torno) and Clase Suelta (Modelado/Torno).
- New direct single-class pages: online booking is disabled while the booking system is being prepared. Ask the studio via WhatsApp about dates and availability; no online availability is published on these pages.
- Clase Suelta is booked online at https://lamesabcn.com/clases/suelta.html.
- WhatsApp (https://wa.me/34711552030): Intro al Torno, Coworking Torno, Taller Flex, creative workshops and private sessions.

## Opening Hours
Closed Monday and Sunday. Same hours as the Google Business Profile (Europe/Madrid):
- Tuesday: 11:00–19:00
- Wednesday: 11:00–20:30
- Thursday: 11:00–19:00
- Friday: 11:00–19:00
- Saturday: 11:00–16:00

Clase Suelta (Modelado or Torno): Tuesday to Saturday, at the time the customer prefers within opening hours, subject to availability (wheels are limited to 2). Book online; if the preferred time is not shown, ask via WhatsApp.

## Languages
Website: Spanish (primary), English, Catalan, Portuguese. Classes are taught in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

## Pottery class for visitors to Barcelona
Main page: https://lamesabcn.com/en/clases/suelta.html (ES https://lamesabcn.com/clases/suelta.html · CA https://lamesabcn.com/ca/clases/suelta.html · PT https://lamesabcn.com/pt/clases/suelta.html)
- 2-hour pottery class in La Barceloneta, no experience needed: hand-building €45 or private wheel throwing for up to 2 people €65. Book online with a live calendar.
- Taught in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
- Clay, tools, glazes and firing included. The piece is ready 15 days after the class; if the visitor leaves Barcelona sooner, La Mesa can ship it to their home (shipping price on request via WhatsApp).
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the class.
- From 8 years old. The studio is wheelchair accessible.
- Address: Carrer de l'Atlàntida 47, La Barceloneta, Barcelona — a short walk from the beach and from Barceloneta metro (L4).
- Reviews: 5.0 on Google (41 reviews, September 2026). Also listed on Tripadvisor and GetYourGuide.

## About
Founded by Lau and Vick. La Mesa is not a traditional school — it is a creative space where people come to make things with their hands, connect with others, and slow down. All materials and firings included. High-temperature clay.
